generalPoints: Healing ability; natural healer; strong need for a partner/companion; seeks an active and supportive person for completeness.
keyPhrase: Natural healer + strong need for an active/supportive partner.

generalPoints: Associated with Duryodhana; strong desires; particularly connected with land, vehicles, possessions, wealth and comforts.
keyPhrase: Strong material desires, especially land, vehicles and possessions.

generalPoints: Separation from parents; possibility of growing up with grandparents/others; parental conflicts; family issues; marital challenges; age difference; inter-caste or unusual marriage circumstances.
keyPhrase: Separation/family issues + marital challenges + unusual partner circumstances.

generalPoints: Associated with Krishna and Prajapati; beauty, intelligence, devotion, ambition and continuous desire for advancement; strong material and financial aspirations.
keyPhrase: Beauty + intelligence + devotion + continuous desire for advancement.

generalPoints: Good Nakshatra; concern for appearance; intelligence, curiosity and persuasive communication; attraction toward opposite gender; love relationships; inter-caste marriage; relationship breaks; strong attraction/lust during relevant periods.
keyPhrase: Attractive, intelligent, curious, persuasive and relationship-oriented.

generalPoints: Workaholic nature; extreme focus on profession; neglect of home/family; emotional pain and tears; suffering through close relationships; late marriage; relationship/marital difficulties.
keyPhrase: Extreme work focus + emotional suffering through close relationships.

generalPoints: Associated with Rama; friendship and support are important for success; right friends can become a major source of achievement; possible disappointment regarding father.
keyPhrase: Success through the right friends/support + possible father-related disappointment.

generalPoints: Associated with Brihaspati/Guru; strong past-life connections; karmic family relationships; family difficulties; parental separation; untimely death or long-term illness in family; good learning ability; multiple subjects; cooking; teaching, HR and protection-oriented professions.
keyPhrase: Strong past-life connection + family karma + learning ability.

generalPoints: Ability to learn multiple subjects; good cooking ability; teaching/HR/protection-related professions; family health concerns including long-term disease, cancer or bedridden family members.
keyPhrase: Multiple learning abilities + cooking + family long-term health concerns.

generalPoints: Symbolized by crown; desire for public respect, recognition, status and social acknowledgment; possible wrong choice of life partner.
keyPhrase: Public respect/recognition + possible wrong choice of life partner.

generalPoints: Ability to help others grow and progress; supportive nature toward others; possible one-sided love, unhappiness or disappointment in romantic relationships.
keyPhrase: Helps others grow + possible one-sided/unhappy love.

generalPoints: Associated with Aryaman; feeling of receiving less parental affection than expected; isolation; staying away from parents; independent learning; possible delayed childbirth.
keyPhrase: Less expected parental affection + isolation/independence + possible delayed childbirth.

generalPoints: Strong work ethic; workaholic; completes assigned responsibilities; expects fair return for effort; sincere and honest; may withdraw after being deceived; decisions can be delayed, creating relationship or professional problems.
keyPhrase: Hardworking, sincere, fairness-oriented, but sometimes slow in decisions.

generalPoints: Particularly emphasized in female charts; relationship complexity; marital separation; divorce; unstable or complicated relationships.
keyPhrase: Relationship complexity, separation and marital complications.

generalPoints: Flexible and adaptable; easily adjusts to circumstances and partners; accommodating nature; anger can occasionally become intense but is generally controlled; relationship/separation difficulties may be more emphasized in female charts.
keyPhrase: Flexible, adjustable and accommodating.

generalPoints: Associated with Indra and Agni; strong creativity in drawing, music and artistic work; ability to transform ordinary things into valuable ones; unusual partner age difference; attraction/fascination toward younger people; possible in-law difficulties.
keyPhrase: High creativity + unusual age-gap relationships + in-law difficulties.

generalPoints: Considered fortunate; associated with Mahalakshmi; financial prosperity particularly after marriage; marriage can become a major turning point for financial stability and wealth.
keyPhrase: Fortune and financial prosperity after marriage + marriage as a turning point for wealth.

generalPoints: Associated with Indra; dependence on luck; luck may be inconsistent; exceptional observation ability; can understand another person's internal thoughts or intentions through observation.
keyPhrase: Dependence on luck + inconsistent fortune + exceptional observation and psychological understanding.

generalPoints: Associated with Nirriti; strong lifelong desire for knowledge; counselling and guidance ability; financial dealings; analytical skills; computer and banking-related work or family connections.
keyPhrase: Lifelong thirst for knowledge + counselling/analysis + banking and computer-related themes.

generalPoints: Life full of challenges; considerable struggle before victory; success after sustained effort; avoid settling in places with scarcity of water; caution regarding getting drenched in rain according to the teaching.
keyPhrase: Life challenges and struggle before victory + caution regarding water.

generalPoints: Associated with Vishvadevas; strong financial yoga; animal symbolism of bear and cow; financial strength can coexist with marital unhappiness or childbirth-related difficulties.
keyPhrase: Strong financial yoga + possible marital or childbirth challenges.

generalPoints: Associated with Vamana and Mahabali; connection with land/property and ownership; property disputes or difficulty establishing ownership; strong desire for honour, recognition and status; work can bring status during Dasha; ability to break others' ego.
keyPhrase: Property/ownership issues + strong desire for recognition, status and honour.

generalPoints: Strong connection with music, singing and listening to music; romantic music may be prominent; native may need a trigger or external motivation to activate potential and achieve success.
keyPhrase: Strong musical inclination + success activated by external motivation.

generalPoints: Difference between external appearance and internal nature; true nature may remain concealed; apparently rough person may be kind, while apparently affectionate person may have different intentions; caution against judging solely by behaviour or exaggerated displays of friendship.
keyPhrase: Hidden inner nature + difference between appearance and reality.

generalPoints: Favourable for financial progress; planets can give financial growth; economical/miserly tendencies; strong savings habit; accumulation through fixed deposits and small consistent reserves; possible connection with astrology, medicine or computers.
keyPhrase: Financial growth + strong saving/accumulation tendency + astrology, medical or computer connection.

generalPoints: Associated with Ahirbudhnya; death-related symbolism; marriage may coincide with death of an older/senior family member; connection with large organisations, MNCs and institutions; during Dasha may bring contact with VIPs, influential people and senior authorities.
keyPhrase: Death/family transition around marriage + large organisations + influential contacts.

generalPoints: Dual tendency of devotion and desire; desire may involve opposite gender and material/financial matters; devotion and sensual/material desires can coexist; possible property loss after birth or birth into a family that has already experienced property loss.
keyPhrase: Devotion and desire coexist + material/relationship desires + possible property-loss themes.
